description: Whether you are in the military, a contractor, or just appreciate military apparel, Rothco’s Combat Uniform Shirt is the ideal choice for you. Made to near Mil-Spec (Military Specification) standards, the army combat shirt is designed with a mandarin collar that can be worn down or up to prevent chafing while wearing body armor. Attach your rank insignia, branch tape or name tape to one of the various loop fields located on the chest of the uniform shirt. Store your essentials in the slash chest pockets and/or the shoulder pockets. Additional loop fields located on the shoulder pockets are great for attaching patches. In addition, the tactical uniform shirt features elbow pad pouches to add padding, a pen pocket on the lower left sleeve, zipper front with flap closure, and adjustable hook and loop wrist cuffs to cinch up around your gloves to prevent elements from entering. Constructed of polyester/rip-stop cotton material, Rothco’s combat shirts are designed to prevent ripping and tearing while you are in the field.
